segments.title: 第110章 二人世界
segments.content:
Rekindling the Verdant Years Chapter 110: A World for Two

"Can you leave a little later after school today?" Yan Zhusheng asked, turning her head on the way to the gymnasium. "I've finished all my homework, so I can stay for the third period to practice."

"I can, I suppose." Li Luo thought about the over ten thousand words he had written that afternoon, and the over two hundred thousand words in his manuscript draft. He didn't mind spending a bit more time in the evening. "But I have to let Xixi know first."

"Okay, sure." Yan Zhusheng nodded. "Are you going to find her now?"

"I'll go upstairs and see if she's in the classroom." As Li Luo said this, he turned around from where he was about to head downstairs and went back up, walking toward the Class One classroom on the fourth floor.

Arriving at the entrance of Class One, Li Luo peered inside.

Most of the people in Class One didn't recognize Li Luo, or rather, they didn't recognize his face.

After all, Li Luo had only delivered a small pudding to Ying Chanxi once during the military training. At all other times, it was basically Ying Chanxi who went to Class Eight to find him.

A girl in the front row near the door saw Li Luo. Not recognizing him, she smiled kindly and reminded him, "Ying Chanxi isn't here, you know. You've come at the wrong time."

Li Luo was taken aback and couldn't help but ask strangely, "How did you know I'm looking for Ying Chanxi? Couldn't I be looking for you?"

"Oh, I know my own place." The girl with the mushroom cut in the front row chuckled. "When an unfamiliar boy from another class comes to our door and looks around, who else could he be looking for but Ying Chanxi?"

"Where is she then?"

"She's probably still in the math competition class. She might not even come back for evening self-study."

"Which classroom is the competition class in?"

"Hehe, I'm not telling you." The girl with the mushroom cut showed a smug smile and rubbed her fingers together. "Other boys who come looking for Ying Chanxi always offer a little something."

"You're charging a toll fee?" Li Luo was dumbfounded.

"Don't put it so crudely. I'm not asking for money." The mushroom-haired girl rolled her eyes. "Some snacks or something would be fine. It's not expensive."

"Li Luo, don't mind her." Liao Hailin, from the back of the class, spotted Li Luo at the front door and hurried over, slinging an arm over his shoulder. "I know where Ying Chanxi has her class. Come on, come on."

Li Luo was led into the hallway by Liao Hailin, completely baffled as to why this guy was suddenly so friendly toward him.

It seemed like the two of them had barely spoken before, right?

But Liao Hailin was incredibly enthusiastic. While leading Li Luo toward the sixth floor, he chuckled sycophantically, "Ying Chanxi is in a classroom on the sixth floor. I can take you there directly. But, could you tell me again, that..."

"What?" Li Luo looked at him with suspicion.

"Is there anything else Ying Chanxi likes? Besides dolls."

"Huh?" Li Luo froze for a moment, unable to understand this guy's train of thought.

Wasn't it that Liu Shaowen fellow who was interested in Ying Chanxi? Why are you, his buddy, also interested?

"Get lost!" At that moment, Liu Shaowen chased after them from the back door, pushed Liao Hailin away, and said irritably, "Li Luo, don't listen to this guy. I'll take you up."

"What's wrong with that?" Liao Hailin became anxious. "What's the big deal if I just ask?"

"I still haven't settled the score with you for last time!" Liu Shaowen glared at him. "Go, go, go."

As he was being led up to the sixth floor by Liu Shaowen, Li Luo asked with a puzzled expression, "So what's going on?"

"What else could it be?" Liu Shaowen said with a speechless look. "Last time, that kid heard that Ying Chanxi likes dolls. When boys from other classes came to ask for information, he used that piece of info to trade for a bunch of snacks and drinks, getting a lot of free stuff. He's gotten a taste for it."

Li Luo: "..."

What kind of paparazzi behavior was this...

He hadn't expected that the pile of doll gifts Ying Chanxi received last time was this kid's doing behind the scenes.

Li Luo was both amused and exasperated, not realizing the students of Fuzhong No. 1 were also so full of gossip.

He originally thought that in a place like Fuzhong No. 1, which was full of top students, everyone would be burying their heads in their books.

But after living here for nearly two months, Li Luo found that apart from being better at their studies, the students here were not much different from ordinary high school students.

He used to have too much of a filter when thinking about Fuzhong No. 1.

"It's in here. They should be on a break right now. You can just go in and find her." Liu Shaowen didn't ask Li Luo for any favors, seemingly planning to build a long-term relationship with him, understanding the principle of casting a long line to catch a big fish. "I'll head down first, bye."

"Oh, thanks."

Li Luo said his thanks, then went to the back door of the classroom, knocked, and said to the people inside, "Ying Chanxi, come out for a second."

Ying Chanxi, sitting in the front row, heard the familiar name and immediately turned her head. When she saw Li Luo, she stood up right away and walked toward the back door.

The others in the class looked over in great surprise.

There were about a dozen people in the classroom, basically the group with the most advanced math skills among the first-years at Fuzhong No. 1.

About half of them were from Class One, while the rest were from Classes Two to Four. They were all promising students handpicked from the math club, specially gathered for extra, targeted training.

The higher one's skill level, the more clearly one understands the strength of their peers.

So this group knew best just how ridiculously strong this girl named Ying Chanxi was in math competitions.

In several internal tests recently, the score rankings of others had fluctuated, but Ying Chanxi alone sat firmly in the number one spot, completely unshakeable.

If any other boy came looking for Ying Chanxi, they would probably be very cautious, walking up to her desk and quietly explaining their reason for being there.

Or they might ask another classmate to help call her out.

Who would be like Li Luo, shouting from the doorway and telling Ying Chanxi to come over to talk?

But neither Li Luo nor Ying Chanxi paid any mind to the onlookers' gazes. Ying Chanxi walked out of the classroom into the hallway and asked Li Luo doubtfully, "What are you here for?"

"To let you know in advance." Li Luo pointed at Yan Zhusheng, who was waiting at the end of the stairwell. "I'm going to the rock club for practice tonight. I'll head back after the third period of evening self-study ends. You don't need to wait for me after school, just go back with the senior sister."

"...Oh, I see." Ying Chanxi glanced at Yan Zhusheng waiting quietly over there and pursed her lips. "I understand then. Good luck with your practice."

The two parted ways in the hallway. Ying Chanxi returned to the classroom, and Li Luo took Yan Zhusheng and hurried to the activity room in the gymnasium.

"Yo, you're here?" Niu Qingling, currently sitting behind the drum set, saw Li Luo and Yan Zhusheng come in and tapped the crash cymbal as a welcome. "Everyone's here. Let's start."

"Let's get to it. I took leave to come here today." Xie Shuchen stood behind the electronic keyboard and sighed, "A huge sacrifice."

He had also been selected by Teacher Sun to participate in the small-group training for the math competition class, but his grades were basically at the bottom.

So when he said it was a huge sacrifice, it wasn't about giving up the competition class studies, but about giving up the opportunity to be in the same classroom as Ying Chanxi.

But in order to shine in the upcoming performance and make Ying Chanxi truly notice him, Xie Shuchen felt this sacrifice was worth it.

On the other side, Shao Youpeng was also full of fighting spirit, holding his bass and throwing himself into the practice with great anticipation.

"During the parent-teacher conference, the teacher told us to perform both songs for the sports meet." Niu Qingling said. "So today, let's practice the song for the closing ceremony."

"Which one are we singing for the closing ceremony?" Li Luo asked curiously.

"Blooming Life." Yan Zhusheng said. "The sheet music is after 'Brave Heart'. You'll see it if you flip the page."

After a round of adjustments and preparations, waves of music and singing soon filled the activity room.

"I want a life in full bloom!"

"Like soaring in the vast sky!"

Once she entered her singing state, Yan Zhusheng seemed to become a completely different person.

Especially when singing songs like "Blooming Life," she could unleash one hundred percent of her energy.

Anyone familiar with Yan Zhusheng's usual demeanor in real life would probably find it hard to imagine that her singing voice could be so explosive and powerful.

It instantly made one feel immersed in the scene.

So much so that the others quickly got into the atmosphere as well, and their coordination was excellent.

Time quickly flowed by like water.

After the bell for the end of the second evening self-study period rang, Niu Qingling and the others packed up their instruments and left the activity room.

Li Luo happened to go to the bathroom. By the time he returned to the activity room, only Yan Zhusheng was left inside.

This stunned him for a moment. He then asked, "Where did they go? To the bathroom too?"

He hadn't run into Xie Shuchen or Shao Youpeng in the bathroom.

Yan Zhusheng blinked, her expression innocent and guileless as she said, "They went back."

"Didn't we say we were staying for the third period of evening self-study to continue practicing?"

"I said *I* could stay and practice. I didn't say *they* would stay too." Yan Zhusheng said with an innocent look. "You don't want to practice anymore?"

The corner of Li Luo's mouth twitched. "...How can we practice if not everyone's here?"

"The first two periods were for practicing the band's overall coordination." Yan Zhusheng said with a straight face. "Now is your personal practice time."

"Practice what?"

"Guitar, of course." Yan Zhusheng said. "You can also practice your singing."

"I don't think it was ever said that I have to be responsible for singing, right? You're the lead singer."

"But after listening to our recent practices, I feel we can do even better." Yan Zhusheng thought for a moment, then analyzed it for Li Luo. "Girls can sing these two rock songs, but my voice is relatively bright. It lacks that kind of tearing feeling."

"If a male voice could neutralize it a bit, it would sound more comfortable."

"For example, in the chorus of 'Brave Heart', I can also use a strained voice to push through it, but it would still be better with a bit of embellishment from a male voice."

Li Luo was silent for a moment, then couldn't help but say, "Don't you think you're being a little too demanding on us? It's just a high school sports meet. Your singing is already perfect."

"On this point alone, I don't agree." Yan Zhusheng shook her head. "If we can do better, why not?"

Looking at Yan Zhusheng's serious eyes, Li Luo smiled helplessly. "Alright, as you wish. But my singing skills aren't as good as yours."

"I'll teach you well."

"Okay, okay, I'll have to trouble Teacher Yan then."

"Student Li." Yan Zhusheng, trying hard to keep a straight face, looked at Li Luo and said with a serious expression, "Let's begin practice."

(End of this chapter)
